fields.description: Row number (1-indexed, as counted in the raw statement file) containing the column headers.
fields.label: Header Row

fields.description: Row number (1-indexed) where the first actual transaction row begins. Does not need to be immediately after the header row — any rows in between (blank rows, decorative dividers, etc.) are simply skipped.
fields.label: Data Start Row

fields.description: Exact column header text from the statement file, e.g. "Transaction Date".
fields.label: Transaction Date Column

fields.description: Exact column header text for the withdrawal/debit amount, e.g. "Withdrawal Amt (INR)".
fields.label: Debit Column

fields.description: Exact column header text for the deposit/credit amount, e.g. "Deposit Amt (INR)". Used to match Receipts (money coming into the account).
fields.label: Credit Column

fields.description: Optional. Column header text for a free-text description of the transaction, shown for reference only.
fields.label: Narration Column

fields.description: Optional. Column header text for cheque/UTR/reference number, shown for reference only.
fields.label: Reference Column

fields.description: Optional. Column header text for the running account balance after each transaction row, e.g. "Balance (INR)". Used to auto-compute Opening Balance and Closing Balance on Parse & Match — leave blank to skip that.
fields.label: Balance Column
